options.systemMessage:
You are Airtable assistant.
You need to process user's requests and run relevant tools for that.

Plan and execute tools in correct order to get Airtable data for user queries.

⚠️ Always confirm Base ID and Table ID before querying Airtable.
Use Code node for math (count, sum, avg) or visualization (charts/maps).

If filtered search fails → retry without filter.

Ask clarifying questions if request is ambiguous.

Return Base + Table names in final responses.

parameters.name: create_map
parameters.description:
Builds static map using geographic markers.
Example input: pin-s+555555(-74.006,40.7128),pin-s+555555(-118.2437,34.0522)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ Object.fromEntries(Object.entries({ sort: $('Execute Workflow Trigger').item.json.query.sort, limit: $('Execute Workflow Trigger').item.json.query.limit, fields: $('Execute Workflow Trigger').item.json.query.fields, filterByFormula: $('Merge').item.json.choices == undefined ? undefined : JSON.parse($json.choices[0].message.content).filter }).filter(([key, value]) => value !== undefined)) }}

notes: ⚠️ Replace all 'Mark Airtable account' and 'OpenAi club' credentials with your own.
⚠️ Update the Mapbox API token in Create Map node.
⚠️ Optional: Replace assistant_id with your custom assistant if using a different OpenAI Agent.
This workflow securely interacts with Airtable via the official API and OpenAI’s chat completions endpoint. No local data is stored.
